name: goodbye-yesterday-rock-intro
title: Goodbye Yesterday: dry rock-crunch intro, produced body
author: monzta1
sources: E Edwards (Elevation Rhythm), official Goodbye Yesterday tutorial: one heavy overdrive played softly through the whole song, a very small room reverb, a minimal couple-repeats delay throughout, a wide stereo delay only from the Refrain
Owner variation (monzta1): open the song on a dry Marshall-style crunch scene, no effects at all, then drop into the produced sound from scene 2
assumes: an 8-scene preset with amp (multi-channel), drive, delay and reverb blocks; scene 1 = intro, scene 2+ = song body

actions.reason: a dedicated crunch channel keeps the clean channel untouched
the JCM800: definitive good-crunch-not-metal rock rhythm
crunch with hair, still not metal; tune to taste
artist spec: minimal delay through the song body
artist spec: small room, very minimal
artist: a room, just very minimal - not a hall

ear_checklist: scene 1: pure dry crunch, rocks on its own with no effects
scene 2: soft picking sings through the drive, never chokes
the room reverb is felt, not heard
levels match between scene 1 and scene 2
